jobs.title: Global Digital & AI Transformation Director Architecture + Urbanism
jobs.description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.

We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.

Role description:

The Architecture + Urbanism Digital & AI Transformation Director
is accountable for rewiring how Architecture + Urbanism
delivers value to clients by embedding digital, data, and AI capabilities into core delivery workflows, decision‑making, and operating rhythms. This role is about changing how work gets done to make better decisions, reduce risk, improve quality and outcomes, and scale what works across Architecture + Urbanism.

Role accountabilities:

Set the Digital & AI direction for the Service Line

Create an Architecture + Urbanism specific digital & AI strategy in the context of our 3yr-out vision and strategy of the Architecture + Urbanism, and the strategic priorities of Industries & Sectors.
Define and regularly update “digital must-win” areas by conducting competitor analyses and gap analysis within existing portfolio of tools and digital products and partnerships.
Identify which Architecture + Urbanism delivery domains and workflows must be redesigned.
Setup collaboration rhythm with Digital Intelligence, Investment governance, pipeline management approach and prioritization framework, change network, CoPs, etc.
Set clear objectives for the transformation that link to overall Architecture + Urbanismperformance metrics.

Own the Opportunity Portfolio

Collect and pro-actively source digital opportunities and use cases within the organization, in close collaboration with peers in other Service Lines and Industries.
Kick-start and actively participate in AI studios around the most promising opportunities, to quickly validate and potentially prototype, ideally in real client settings.
Work closely together with Digital Intelligence counterparts to make buy/build/partner decisions, as well as start/continue/stop decisions, following pre-set guidelines.
Actively stop or kill initiatives that do not demonstrate clear value, adoption potential, or strategic fit.
Participate regularly in client conversations to better understand client needs
Act as primary interface and product sponsor to product managers, e.g., help get funding, set requirements, mobilize business SME involvement, anything needed to deliver at pace.

Rewire Service Delivery workflows

Redesign end‑to‑end Architecture + Urbanism delivery workflows to embed digital and AI where they materially improve outcomes.
Work with Service Line leadership to support adjustments to new ways of working

Embed Digital & AI in our capabilities and drive adoption

Build a local network of digital & AI champions (change agents and catalysts) within each Service Area Group.
Strengthen foundational digital skills and AI usage within the organization (e.g., Drive Citizen Development participation, measure and steer on AI usage, make part of SPO)
Setup adoption campaigns around new tooling / digital products, and ways of working, incl. training programs and updated global procedures.

Strengthen data foundations and other boundary conditions

Turn global data strategy into an actionable plan within the service line, with clear focus around the priority areas (digital must-wins).
Create knowledge and data libraries around discipline areas, managed within Communities of Practice.
Setup data governance (who collects, who structures and maintains) and measure adherence and progress.
Define any other pre-requisites for digital innovation and bake into transformation plan.
Own the Architecture + Urbanism Digital and AI innovation backlog and roadmap, in partnership with Digital Intelligence, ensuring alignment to strategic priorities and measurable value delivery.
Drive investment prioritisation and portfolio transparency within the Innovation governance framework, enabling clear decision-making and optimal allocation of resources.
Champion digital adoption across the Architecture + Urbanism workforce and project delivery, working closely with Services leadership to embed tools, behaviours, and ways of working that maximise impact.

Qualifications & Experience:

Extensive leadership experience building and scaling global digital, AI, automation or technology-enabled capabilities within the AEC or related professional services industry, with clear accountability for capability maturity, business value and enterprise impact. Candidates need to have demonstrated experience in the field of Architecture + Urbanism.
Experience embedding responsible AI principles, including governance, transparency, human oversight, risk mitigation and regulatory alignment into enterprise AI adoption and operational practices.
Proven strategic leadership in defining and executing a global Digital & AI capability vision aligned to business goals, enterprise priorities and long-term transformation objectives.
Deep expertise in digital, AI, automation and emerging technologies, with a strong understanding of how these can be applied to improve delivery models, business performance and client outcomes within complex organizational environments.
Demonstrated experience driving organizational change and broad adoption of new digital and AI capabilities, tools and ways of working across global and local teams.
Strong track record of identifying, sponsoring and scaling successful innovations, pilots and proof of concept initiatives into practical, repeatable and value-adding business capabilities.
Proven ability to influence and align senior stakeholders across global, regional and local teams, building commitment to shared priorities and securing support for transformation roadmaps and implementation plans.
Strong understanding of scalable delivery models, process optimization and operational excellence, with experience designing approaches that improve consistency, efficiency and quality in digital and AI-enabled services.
Governance and risk management experience, including understanding of data privacy, AI ethics, information security and relevant compliance requirements, with the ability to embed these into capability design, deployment and ongoing management.
Demonstrated talent and capability development experience, including building learning programs, enabling skills development and fostering communities of practice that strengthen digital, data and AI capability across the organization.
Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to connect cross-functional teams around a unified transformation agenda and deliver outcomes across a complex matrixed environment.
Demonstrated strategic judgment and execution discipline, with the ability to translate vision into clear priorities, practical roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
Leadership style that empowers Arcadians, promotes accountability and continuous improvement, and supports a healthy, inclusive and high engagement culture aligned to the Arcadis Leadership profile of being curious, driving success and igniting passion.
Degree level education in a relevant technical or commercial discipline such as digital technology, data science, artificial intelligence, computer science, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Advanced degree preferred such as an MBA or a relevant Master’s in artificial intelligence, data science, digital transformation, technology management, engineering, business or a related field, or equivalent executive level experience in complex global organizations.

Job Description

WHAT IS THE OPPORTUNITY?

The Enterprise Chief Controls Office (ECCO) is a centralized first line of defense group (1LOD) with the goal of embedding a culture of risk ownership and operational excellence by elevating the control environment and driving consistency and quality of risk practices to minimize loss and regulatory sanction, drive cost efficiencies, and accelerate execution to enable growth. The Operational Resilience and Business Continuity Management (BCM) team provide leadership in designing and implementing strategic vision, long-term operational model, roadmap and program governance across our platforms in the 1LOD. Working in partnership with platform and business unit Operational Resilience, BCM and Incident Management teams, this central team drives an enterprise-wide strategy to strengthen first line capabilities by driving consistent risk and control practices, embedding resilience into the way we lead, operate and respond to disruption while enabling critical business outcomes. The team is integral in evolving the operating model, governance, and relationship to other resilience risk areas, serving as a single first-line voice to unify, standardize and elevate Resilience capabilities in alignment with ECCO's mandate to embed risk ownership and operational excellence across the organization

The Enterprise Chief Controls Office & Strategic Execution team (ECCO & SE) is seeking a visionary Director of Resilience CoE Strategy & Transformation to architect RBC's transformational initiative uplift Business Continuity Management and Operational Resilience capabilities across the enterprise. In this role, you will work closely with senior leadership to support the development and execution of RBC's multi-year operational resilience and BCM strategic program while driving enterprise-wide maturity progression across BCM and Operational Resilience capabilities. You will establish strategic milestones, embed industry best practices, and lead the consolidation of fragmented capabilities into a cohesive, best-in-class function. Collaborating across business platforms and functions to align strategic priorities, you will research emerging resilience trends and drive stakeholder engagement to transform resilience from a compliance mandate into a strategic competitive advantage. You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The AVP Technology Lead – Digital is a strategic technology leader responsible for enabling, scaling, and modernizing Sun Life Canada’s shared digital platforms that support secure, connected, and frictionless Client and advisor experiences. This role provides technology leadership across core digital assets including Secure Web, Public Web, & Secure Mobile, and related enablement platforms such as client identity and access management, and an internal design system.

The role combines strategic leadership, technical oversight, people leadership, delivery execution, operational accountability, and vendor/financial management to drive technology excellence and measurable business value. The AVP partners closely with Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, Engineering, and Business leaders to ensure digital assets are resilient, scalable, secure, reusable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.

This role operates in a complex, high-visibility environment where digital platform reliability, modernization, and cross-business enablement are critical to Client outcomes. The leader must be able to bring clarity to a broad mandate, make decisions in ambiguity, and build a high-performing technology organization that balances speed, stability, security, and long-term platform health.

What will you do?

Technology Strategy, Platform Enablement & Engineering
Shape, communicate, and align the digital technology strategy across business units, ensuring it supports near-term delivery commitments and longer-term modernization objectives.
Partner with Business Leads, Product, Client Experience, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Operations, and Enterprise Technology to define platform roadmaps, OKRs, sequencing, and investment priorities.
Provide thought leadership on the evolution of shared digital platforms, including identity, web, mobile, integration, data enablement, and reusable digital capabilities.
Promote technology stack standards, modern engineering practices, automation, and architectural discipline, balancing build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in a complex technology ecosystem.
Ensure design and engineering decisions account for reusability, scalability, security, maintainability, accessibility, and technical debt reduction.
Create the conditions for exceptional digital experiences by enabling business and product teams with reliable, scalable, secure, and reusable platforms.
Platform Delivery & Execution
Accountable for end-to-end delivery of digital platform capabilities, including oversight of internal delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and total cost of ownership.
Drive delivery excellence by improving velocity, quality, reliability, predictability, and agile maturity across multiple squads.
Track delivery metrics, identify bottlenecks, and implement targeted productivity and delivery maturity improvements.
Serve as the primary escalation point for platform, delivery, vendor, and dependency-related issues, enabling rapid resolution in a complex environment.
Ensure delivery is integrated across product, architecture, engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and business priorities.
Embed test-and-learn, automation, and continuous improvement practices to improve speed, quality, and sustainability.
People Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, mentor, and develop technology leaders and teams, fostering a collaborative, inclusive, accountable, and execution-focused culture.
Design and optimize team structures to support clear ownership, delivery outcomes, modernization priorities, and clear accountabilities.
Partner with Chapter, Engineering, Product, and Business leaders on workforce planning, role clarity, succession planning, and capability development.
Build internal capability in digital engineering, enablement, agile delivery, vendor management, and operational excellence.
Coach leaders to manage performance effectively, clarify ownership, and build resilient teams through change and transformation.
Financial & Vendor Management
Lead budget management, including annual planning, cost tracking, capitalization, forecasting, and investment prioritization.
Manage strategic vendor and system integrator relationships, holding partners accountable for delivery quality, outcomes, knowledge transfer, and value realization.
Drive cost transparency and technology spend optimization across applications, infrastructure, security, vendor, and platform investments.
Identify opportunities to reduce long-term dependency on external partners while strengthening internal platform ownership and capability.
Operational Excellence, Risk & Security
Ensure stability, security, technology currency, resiliency, and end-of-life decommissioning for applications within scope.
Establish governance processes that balance speed of delivery with risk management, audit, regulatory, cybersecurity, and control requirements.
Partner with Application Operations to ensure effective incident management, change management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning.
Proactively manage operational risk, application health, technical debt, and service reliability across shared digital capabilities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement
Act as a strategic technology partner to leaders across Product, Client Experience, Business, Operations, Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Technology.
Communicate digital strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and dependencies with clarity and transparency.
Represent the Digital technology function in executive forums, bringing enterprise perspective, external insight, and pragmatic recommendations.
Strengthen alignment between technology investments, business priorities, Client experience outcomes, and enterprise digital strategy.

Accountabilities

Align digital strategy with business objectives, Client outcomes, enterprise standards, and shared technology priorities.
Define and monitor roadmaps, OKRs, modernization priorities, and delivery sequencing.
Oversee execution across delivery teams, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise partners.
Establish governance, track delivery metrics, and drive productivity, quality, and reliability improvements.
Manage budgets, vendor relationships, and cost optimization opportunities.
Build and sustain a high-performing, engaged, inclusive, and platform-oriented technology organization.
Ensure digital platforms are secure, scalable, resilient, reusable, and positioned to support future growth.

What you need to succeed?

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree or MBA is an asset.
10+ years of experience in senior technology leadership roles with demonstrated success delivering complex, mission-critical digital platforms.
Experience leading modernization and enablement of digital platforms such as identity, web, mobile, integration, or client/advisor experience platforms.
Proven ability to lead technology teams through transformation, platform ownership, and operating model evolution.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing sizable technology budgets, vendor portfolios, and total cost of ownership.
Strong stakeholder management, executive communication, and organizational leadership skills.
Experience in regulated financial services is valuable; depth in digital enablement, engineering excellence, and vendor-heavy delivery environments is prioritized.

Mindset & Behaviours

Decisive leader comfortable operating in ambiguity, complexity, and transformation.
Strong technical credibility with the ability to challenge architecture, delivery practices, platform decisions, and CI/CD approaches.
Builder mindset with equal focus on fixing, scaling, enabling, and simplifying.
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven decision-maker who balances speed, stability, risk, and long-term application health.

Our client is a leading global financial institution undertaking a major enterprise-wide Finance transformation initiative. This individual will combine executive-level leadership, stakeholder management, and transformation delivery expertise with a strong understanding of SAP Finance, subledger platforms, event-based accounting, and enterprise ledger modernization.

This is an outstanding opportunity for a senior transformation leader who has successfully led complex SAP Finance implementations and can drive delivery across global teams, multiple workstreams, and executive stakeholders.

Establish delivery standards, governance frameworks, KPIs, and program controls to ensure successful outcomes

Serve as the primary delivery lead across functional, technical, data, and integration teams

Ensure adherence to SAP governance standards and global template design principles
Drive enterprise-wide stakeholder engagement and executive communications
Lead geographically distributed teams of consultants, architects, developers, analysts, and delivery partners
Manage scope, risks, dependencies, budgets, and competing priorities across multiple workstreams
Resolve complex delivery and technology challenges while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture standards
Ensure the final platform is scalable, secure, resilient, and capable of supporting future business growth
Provide thought leadership on Finance technology strategy, modernization, and regulatory requirements
Build high-performing teams through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and leadership development

Must-Have Qualifications

15+ years of SAP implementation and transformation experience
Proven experience leading large-scale SAP Finance transformation programs within global financial institutions or top-tier consulting organizations
Deep expertise in Product Subledger, Financial Products Subledger (FPSL), Enterprise General Ledger, and event-based accounting environments
Experience delivering greenfield SAP Finance implementations from strategy and design through deployment and stabilization
Strong understanding of Finance, accounting, and enterprise ledger processes within banking or financial services environments
Demonstrated success leading multi-workstream programs involving architecture, integration, data migration, reporting, testing, and deployment
Experience establishing governance frameworks and managing global template design across multiple entities or business units
Executive-level stakeholder management experience, including working with senior technology and business leaders
Proven ability to lead globally distributed teams across complex transformation initiatives
Strong knowledge of enterprise architecture principles, SDLC methodologies, Agile delivery, and cloud-based platforms

RouteThis is 10 years in and moving from a SaaS business to an AI-native one. That shift changes the shape of the P&L, the way revenue is recognized and the questions leadership needs Finance to answer. The Director, Finance leads the function through it.

You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Opportunity

Lead a transformational technology organization powering health and benefits experiences for millions. As the Assistant Vice-President (AVP), Technology Lead
, you will own one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios
for health benefits claims adjudication/processing, virtual health, and online pharmacy systems
.

You will lead a 250+ person technology professional organization
including 5 Directors across multiple high-performing squads in a matrixed environment. This is your chance to shape strategy, drive modernization, and build a world-class engineering culture that balances breakthrough innovation with operational excellence.

You'll partner with executives across Architecture, Product, Operations, and Business to define the future of Sun Life's health technology platforms including mission-critical mainframe systems to cutting-edge digital experiences—while managing complex vendor ecosystems and driving sustainable delivery practices.

This role is highly visible, mission-critical to Sun Life Canada’s core business, strategically influential, and demands a leader who thrives in complexity.

Why This Role Matters

You'll lead a strategic inflection point for Sun Life's health benefits claims and on-line health technology organization. Leading one of Sun Life Canada’s largest technology portfolios and 250+ technology professionals, you have the scale, resources, and mandate to drive meaningful modernization while serving millions of members. This is a high-visibility opportunity to influence enterprise technology strategy, build a best-in-class engineering culture, and deliver business impact in a complex, mission-critical environment.

What You'll Own

Technology Strategy & Modernization Leadership

Define and communicate a compelling technology vision that bridges near-term delivery with long-term platform modernization across health benefits claims, adjudication systems, online health platforms, and core systems of record.
Lead evolution of Sun Life's health technology ecosystem—making bold build vs. buy vs. partner decisions in an extremely large technology portfolio
Champion modern engineering practices, technology standards, and architectural excellence while actively managing technical debt in complex, non-greenfield environments
Partner with Business, Architecture, and Enterprise Technology leaders to design resilient, scalable platforms that deliver exceptional member and sponsor experiences

Delivery Excellence at Scale

Accountable for end-to-end delivery across multiple agile squads at varying maturity levels—driving velocity, quality, and reliability improvements
Manage relationships with system integrators and vendors, holding partners accountable for outcomes and knowledge transfer
Serve as the primary escalation point for critical platform and delivery issues in a mission-critical environment
Transform delivery metrics into actionable insights and drive continuous improvement

People Leadership & Culture Building

Lead, mentor, and develop 250+ technology professionals across 5 Director level reports and cross-functional teams
Foster a collaborative, inclusive, execution-focused culture rooted in psychological safety and continuous learning
Design high-performing team structures aligned with business outcomes and technical excellence
Build and retain technical talent through coaching, career development, and hands-on leadership

Financial & Strategic Vendor Management

Own platform budgeting, cost optimization, and capitalization decisions
Manage strategic vendor and SI relationships to maximize delivery quality and ROI
Drive alignment between IT spend and business value delivery

Governance & Risk Management

Establish governance that accelerates delivery while meeting regulatory and security requirements
Ensure platform stability, security, and effective incident/change management for mission-critical systems
Partner with Operations on disaster recovery and business continuity for enablement platforms

Who You Are

Experience & Expertise

10+ years in senior technology leadership roles for very large technology portfolios, with proven success delivering complex, mission-critical systems at enterprise scale
Track record modernizing and enabling technology platforms.
Experience working in a health benefits claims / health industry is good to have
Strong financial acumen—comfortable managing large budgets, vendor portfolios, and ROI optimization
Demonstrated ability to lead technology teams through transformation while maintaining operational excellence
Knowledge with Mainframe environments and their integration with modern and digital business-critical systems is good to have

Technical Credibility & Mindset

Strong technical foundation with the credibility to challenge architecture, delivery practices, CI/CD, and engineering approaches
Builder mentality—equally focused on fixing legacy systems, scaling capabilities, and enabling teams
Decisive leader comfortable making clear decisions amid ambiguity and complexity
Pragmatic, outcomes-driven thinker who balances innovation with stability
Collaborative leader who rebuilds trust, drives momentum, and fosters transparency

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (MBA or advanced degree is an asset)
Experience in regulated health, insurance or financial services is valuable

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

What’s in it for you?

Flexible hybrid work model.
Pension, stock and savings programs to help build and enhance your future financial security
Work and professional development that is united by our Purpose: to help Clients and Employees achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives
A friendly, collaborative and inclusive culture
Be part of our continuous improvement journey in developing the next greatest digital enterprise experience.
Competitive salary and bonus structure influenced by market range data
The opportunity to move along a variety of career paths with amazing networking potential

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Position Description

The Director, Strategy & Partnerships provides leadership for ESA's enterprise strategy function and supports a structured, organization-wide approach to strategic partnerships that advance ESA's public safety mandate, strategic plan, modernization agenda, collaboration objectives, and Vision. The role is responsible for leading enterprise strategic planning, strategy execution monitoring, performance measurement and reporting, strategic analysis, and partnership development activities that strengthen organizational alignment, support executive decision-making, identify emerging opportunities and risks, and enable achievement of ESA's long-term objectives.

The role establishes frameworks, governance processes, and enterprise-wide approaches that help translate strategic priorities into actionable initiatives and measurable outcomes across the organization. The role also supports a more deliberate and coordinated approach to identifying, prioritizing, governing, and evaluating strategic partnerships that enhance collaboration, support public safety outcomes, and strengthen ESA's ability to address emerging sector opportunities and challenges.

Role Description

Leads the development, coordination, and ongoing refresh of ESA's enterprise strategic planning process, corporate strategic plan, and related strategic planning activities across the organization.
Works closely with senior leadership to translate strategic priorities into business plans, operational objectives, implementation roadmaps, and clearly defined accountabilities across the organization.
Leads the development and ongoing enhancement of strategic planning, strategy management, and enterprise performance measurement frameworks to strengthen organizational alignment and execution discipline.
Monitors organizational progress against strategic objectives and key initiatives, identifying barriers to execution, opportunities, emerging issues, and corrective actions to support achievement of desired outcomes.
Facilitates and coordinates, in collaboration with other business functions, enterprise strategic analysis, environmental scanning, research, and evidence-based recommendations regarding sector trends, modernization opportunities, emerging risks, public safety priorities, regulatory developments, stakeholder needs, and strategic opportunities that may affect ESA's future direction.
Develops executive and Board-level briefings, presentations, reports, dashboards, and recommendations that support strategic decision-making and enterprise governance processes.
Facilitates strategic planning sessions, leadership discussions, and cross-functional engagement activities to build alignment around organizational priorities and strategic objectives.
Works collaboratively with leaders across ESA to identify and address cross-functional dependencies, organizational barriers, and alignment challenges that may impact strategy execution or achievement of enterprise priorities.
Supports the development and continuous improvement of governance frameworks, decision-making processes, strategic reporting mechanisms, and enterprise planning practices that strengthen organizational effectiveness and accountability.
Leads ESA's enterprise partnership strategy and governance framework, including partnership principles, governance processes, prioritization criteria, performance measures, and evaluation approaches that support consistent partnership management across the organization.
Identifies, evaluates, and coordinates strategic partnership opportunities that support ESA's public safety mandate, collaboration priorities, modernization objectives, and long-term strategic goals.
Works with internal stakeholders to assess partnership opportunities, define partnership objectives, establish governance structures, and ensure appropriate alignment with ESA's strategic priorities, regulatory obligations, and organizational capacity, while supporting accountable business areas in the management of partnership relationships.
Monitors the effectiveness and outcomes of strategic partnerships and provides enterprise-level recommendations to strengthen partnership governance, collaboration, value realization, and achievement of partnership objectives.
Develops, monitors and reports on departmental objectives, performance measures and operational plans.
Responsible for departmental planning, budget management, resource allocation and oversight.
Establishes effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders and promotes collaboration, partnership, and knowledge sharing across the organization.
Ensures team members understand and comply with applicable legal, regulatory, policy, health and safety, and business requirements related to their work.
Promotes and models ESA’s values, Code of Conduct and leadership expectations.
Fosters a high-performing team culture focused on delivery excellence, innovation and customer service.

Qualifications & Requirements

University degree in Business Administration, Public Administration or a related discipline.
Minimum 8-10 years of progressive experience in strategy, enterprise planning, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation, management consulting, public sector modernization, or related fields, including experience leading teams and advising senior executives.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise strategic planning processes and translating strategy into actionable plans, performance measures, governance mechanisms, and organizational outcomes.
Demonstrated experience providing strategic advice, analysis, and recommendations to senior executives, leadership teams, and governing bodies.
Experience applying strategic frameworks, research, business analysis, and performance measurement disciplines to support complex organizational decisions and priorities.
Experience developing business cases, strategic analyses, executive briefings, Board materials, and recommendations for senior leadership audiences.
Experience developing, coordinating, or managing strategic partnerships, cross-sector collaborations, stakeholder initiatives, or multi-organization programs.
Strong understanding of strategic planning, performance measurement, governance, organizational effectiveness, and strategy execution disciplines.
Demonstrated ability to influence, facilitate, and build alignment across multiple stakeholder groups with competing priorities and perspectives.
Strong analytical, conceptual, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
Strong written, verbal, presentation, and facilitation skills, including the ability to communicate complex issues clearly to executive and Board-level audiences.
Strong project leadership and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex and evolving environment.
Knowledge of regulatory organizations, delegated administrative authorities, public sector governance, or the electricity sector is considered an asset.
